units.note: Lexical only, outside error classes: 'like some sudden stroke of fortune' renders ὥσπερ ἐκ προσπαίου τινὸς τύχης (as if by some sudden chance), and 'made evident by events themselves' drops the subject ἡ τύχη (Fortune). Sense not inverted.
Lexical only: πικρίᾳ is 'bitterness', rendered 'volatility'. No inversion; μὲν/δέ order (Athens/Thebes) is kept.
'by hereditary right' goes beyond ἀΐδιον (perpetual), but adds no wrong fact.
Slight softening: 'almost the same language' and 'could hardly tell' for ταῖς λέξεσι ταῖς αὐταῖς and κατὰ μηδένα τρόπον. Not a reversal.
Lexical only: νενεμημένους (entered/registered for the contest) is rendered 'won recognition'.
